lines.english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
lines.english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏔᎵ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎤᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏥᎩ.
lines.english: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎲᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᎲᎦ.
lines.english: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎤᏃᏣᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᎲᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ-ᎤᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎲᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
lines.english: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
